title: personal-experiment-mini-sheet-llm-tuning-tracker
content:
Quick personal mini-sheet to track small LLM tuning experiments (short-lived; informal).

Columns: id | date | model | variant | quant | batch | lr | prompt_set | eval_metric | tokens/sec | notes

Rows (most recent first):
1 | 2025-02-20 | redwood-v1-base | 8-bit-qat | 8-bit | 8 | 1e-5 | convo-v2-short | accuracy@top1: 0.72 | 420 | reduced lr, small prompt augment; noisy on long context
2 | 2025-02-14 | redwood-v1-base | fp16 | none | 16 | 2e-5 | convo-v2-short | accuracy@top1: 0.68 | 380 | baseline for weekly compare; stable
3 | 2025-01-30 | redwood-v1-llm | 4-bit-quant | 4-bit | 32 | 5e-6 | summarization-mini | rougeL: 0.41 | 760 | huge throughput improvement; slight drop in quality on abstractive tasks
4 | 2024-12-18 | meta-open-7b | int8 | 8-bit | 16 | 1e-5 | convo-v1 | accuracy@top1: 0.65 | 310 | reference open model run

Interpretation notes:
- 4-bit quant looks promising for throughput but need to validate on the long-context eval set (currently only short convo prompts).
- 8-bit QAT improved accuracy vs naive int8; consider another epoch with lr=8e-6.

Short checklist / next steps:
- [ ] Run 4-bit variant on long-context dataset (eval_long_ctx_v1) and record latency + quality (target: <0.5% accuracy drop).
- [ ] Try lr sweep for 8-bit QAT (1e-5, 8e-6, 5e-6) — track overfit signs (perplexity on holdout).
- [ ] Add prefix caching on inference for convo-v2-short and re-measure tokens/sec.
- [ ] Convert top two promising runs to a small perf/quality PR for the team (include cost delta).

Quick formulas / notes for manual calc:
- tokens/sec measured on local dev rig (A100-sim) — multiply by 0.9 for cloud estimate.
- cost/kg-token delta ~ (throughput_baseline / throughput_variant) * unit_cost. (very rough)

Scratchpad thoughts:
- Might be worth gating 4-bit experiments behind a small eval harness that runs nightly on 500 prompts. If quality is stable, we can propose a canary rollout for Dedicated pools.
- Save the prompt_set id mapping in a separate Confluence page (linked_artifacts).

Recent links (for reference):
- Eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/tree/exp-runs
- Run logs: s3://redwood-ml-logs/evan/2025-02

Notes to self: keep this sheet lightweight. Move anything we intend to share to product/PRD folder or a proper sheet with computed columns.
